CHAPTER 26
SNACKS AND DESSERTS
M any athletes enjoy snacks and desserts as part of their daily food plans.
Fresh fruits are ideal choices for either, yet there is a time and a place
for other sweets. The trick is to choose snacks and desserts that are low in
saturated fat and rich in wholesome carbohydrate. These recipes provide
healthy alternatives to empty-calorie temptations.

Peanut butter and other nut butters like almond, cashew, and sunflower
seed are a staple for hungry athletes who want a satisfying, wholesome
snack. Nut butters offer a lot of calories from fat, but the fat is unsaturated
and can healthfully fit into your sports diet.
If you are a nut butter lover, you can spread it on bread, bananas, graham
crackers, and apple slices. For a real treat, slit open a few dates (remove
the pit, if needed), stick in a few dark-chocolate chips, and top with a dab
of peanut butter. Now that will cure your sweet tooth!
